items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: So, but Eddie French. Albert French. Albert French. He really, and the one who sings on the mic. I don't know his name, but he sings all the Creole favorites.

ctx.x: It looked like better than ever. And I'm really proud because he was so proud of his band and to let it go down, it would be a shame. But they're really keeping it up.

Oh, they're keeping it up. Very good. I often ask him what he would do in his band when he'd be gone. He says, well, I tried to teach the youngsters, but they won't listen. I say, but please leave somebody in your place. Just don't pass on and don't, you know, don't leave that to someone. So, but Eddie French. Albert French. Albert French. He really, and the one who sings on the mic. I don't know his name, but he sings all the Creole favorites.
All the Creole. All the. Brother Cornbread. His name is Joseph Thomas, but they call him.
